page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet, with no printed book text. Top right is the e-rara logo. Centre is the title information (catalogue data, not book text). Below are two horizontal rules, with the e-rara description in German, English, French and Italian between them, then the terms of use in the same four languages. page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. It shows the e-rara logo, the catalogue data for the digitised item (Aristotle, Aristotelous tou Stageiritou Ta Sōzomena, [Genève], 1597, Bibliothèque de Genève, shelf mark Ca 251, persistent link), the e-rara descriptions, the terms of use and the Visual Library logo.
